Subject: Intro: MAP starter sync — confirming goals, roles, and closing milestones

Hi Sofia —

Great to meet you last week. As discussed, I wanted to open a short MAP (mutual action plan) thread so we can align on success criteria, owners, and a realistic close timeline. Below is a suggested starter plan and a few asks to make the initial kickoff efficient.

Quick context and objective:
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference in a pilot that demonstrates 50% reduction in inference latency for the primary clinical summarization pipeline while keeping >97% output parity.
- Run: 4-week technical eval followed by a 60-day pilot for production readiness and throughput validation.

Starter timeline (proposed) — high level:
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm champion, stakeholders, and success metrics
- Week 1: Kickoff + environment access & security review
- Weeks 2–3: Integration + short eval runs (short prompt set)
- Week 4: Quality review and performance tuning
- Week 6–8: Pilot (if greenlit)

Initial asks (can you confirm by EOD Wed?):
1) Confirm your internal champion and primary technical contact
2) Confirm the two success metrics (latency target and parity threshold or alternate metric)
3) Flag any procurement timelines or PO/contract constraints that will affect close date

Stakeholders I suggest including on the kickoff: you (champion), engineering lead for model integration, procurement, and one Security/InfoSec contact (for the SOC 2 evidence review).

I attached a short starter MAP spreadsheet and an agenda for a 30-minute kickoff. If this looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue Oct 5th or Wed Oct 6th (30 min) — what works best for your team?

Attachments: novum_MAP_v1.xlsx (starter MAP), MAP_kickoff_agenda.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/8910
Drive (starter assets): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPstarter

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. Happy to be the internal champion for this work. Quick answers below: 

- Champion: Sofia Ramos (Head of AI Strategy) — primary technical contact will be Miguel Alvarez (miguel.alvarez@novumhealth.com)
- Success metrics: target 50% median inference latency reduction for the clinical summarizer (p95 target 800ms), and maintain >=98% content parity on the evaluation set we discussed.
- Procurement: procurement timeline is likely 4–6 weeks for our standard SOW/PO process; however, we can run the technical eval under an MSA addendum if needed to shorten. Procurement is cc'd here.

I can do Tue Oct 5th at 10:30am PT for a 30-minute kickoff. Please include Security (I’ll loop in our InfoSec reviewer in the next message) and Miguel.
